手順・やり方.quote: How to Reconcile Conflicting Market Data Without Inventing Certainty | SellersGPT
How to Reconcile Conflicting Market Data Without Inventing Certainty
Two credible sources can disagree without either being wrong. The conflict often comes from different definitions, scopes, classifications, periods, valuations, revisions, or measurement methods.

Reconcile conflicting market data by preserving each original value, documenting its definition and method, identifying the exact dimension of disagreement, converting only compatible fields, testing revisions and exclusions, and reporting the result as a supported value, range, scenario, or unresolved question. Never average incompatible figures merely to produce one answer.
